reviews.title: Opted out of ads so why does Bell keep pushing ads to MyBell app’s homepage
reviews.text:
Opted out of ads after opening MyBell app so WHY do ads for latest and greatest smartphone keep showing up on app’s homepage ????

Ad requires user to login. So not only is user exposed to unwanted ad, there’s also the hassle of inability to access data usage info without logging in.

To get around this, user can uninstall and reinstall app - using 245 mb of data - but within 48 hrs, same smartphone ad shows up on homepage requiring login.

Why isn’t Bell respecting app users who’ve opted out of ads?
